description: This PHP class defines a data model for vacancy summaries within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It serializes vacancy data for API responses, implementing normalization through the ModelTrait and defining schema properties using OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: VacancySummaryModel
classes.description: A model representing a summary view of a vacancy, used for serialization in API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Vacancy entity and sets up serialization parameters.
